verdict.rationale: AFK's docs explicitly describe scoped OAuth tokens, encrypted secrets, automatic key rotation, and minimal permissions with full audit logs, directly matching the least-privilege credential story. However, this is vendor-claimed only with no independent verification, API/OpenAPI documentation, or technical detail on how scoping is configured or issued to agents. Missing for 10: independent/hands-on corroboration, technical documentation (API/openapi) confirming credential scoping mechanics, and detail on how granular the scoping controls are.
